readme.title: Release Radar export
readme.scope_view: Rows: the releases shown on the Data page, {count} in all.
readme.state_value: A number was recorded. 0 is a real zero.
readme.state_na: N/A: the number can't exist for this release, such as Altmetric without a DOI.
readme.state_empty: Empty: not recorded yet, or not due yet.
readme.year: The academic year comes from the release date. A release code keeps the year it was given, even if the date moved later.
readme.colleagues: A column with a name in brackets is that person's own field.
readme.personal: This file contains personal data, such as researchers' names. Keep it within the office and delete copies you no longer need.
